svg.aria-label: Perfectly inelastic trolley collision showing momentum before and after the trolleys stick together
svg.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 1; fill-rule: nonzero; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0px; opacity: 1; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: Arial; text-anchor: start; marker: none; clip-path: none;
svg.title: Perfectly inelastic trolley collision showing momentum before and after the trolleys stick together
